_comment: Championship Photos page (championship-photos.html, Media menu). Photos show in this order. Each: 'src' (full size), 'thumb' (grid image), 'title' (e.g. 'West Essex Football'), 'caption' (e.g. 'North I Group II Sectional Champions'), 'alt' (what the photo shows, for screen readers). A photo with no title is labelled 'Photo N' so it can be referred to by number.
